title: Advancing AI Trustworthiness Through Patient Simulation: Risk Assessment of Conversational Agents for Antidepressant Selection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI concept retrieval and downstream recommendation accuracy across simulated patient conversations with varying levels of health literacy (Limited, Functional, and Proficient), analyzing how precise terminology vs. colloquial language affects system reliability.

Measuring the AI's diagnostic and recommendation performance across different simulated patient interaction behaviors (Structured & Cooperative, Distracted & Unfocused, and Adversarial & Combative) to assess robustness against interactional disruptions.
